title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
slides: Why did Replit just drop OpenAI's rival?

thread_text:
1. OpenAI Is Now Default

Replit just made OpenAI its default AI provider, sidelining Anthropic. The switch affects every user on the platform.

2. The CEO's Verdict

Replit's CEO said Anthropic's models fell behind. That's a direct critique from someone who once relied on them.

3. Your Workflow Could Flip

If you use Replit, your coding tools may shift to OpenAI overnight. No opt-in, no warning.

4. Check Your Model Today

Find out which model powers your workflow right now. The default may have already changed.

5. Test Before You Trust

Run a prompt you know well on the new default. If the output feels off, you have your answer.
